description: Tráfego Rodoviário na Avenida Saraiva de Carvalho is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by José Eduardo Gil Andrade. Road Traffic on Avenida Saraiva de Carvalho between the days 20/10 and 09/10, obtained through the DRMS ( Simple Movement Radar Detector), installed in a UMICS (Modular Unit for Lighting, Communications and Sensing), within the scope of the Project "SMART IP FigFoz". [. Coverage: José Eduardo Gil Andrade. The portal shows the English title as "Bus Traffic on Avenida Saraiva de Carvalho" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is José Eduardo Gil Andrade. Its keywords include drms. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
